_comment: The white thought bubble that pops over the player's head while a thought is on screen (see HeadMarker / docs/design/HUD.md). A cloud on a short stem whose base sits at the head; holds while the reading is up, fades on dismiss. size = sprite cell px; head_offset = world px above the feet-anchored player origin where the stem meets the head; peak_alpha = shown opacity; fade_speed = alpha lerp rate; pulse_amp/pulse_hz = idle breathing. Tune by feel.
